plain_english_note: This map explains routing and portfolio boundaries. It does not prove behavior, require mergers, or replace the canonical skill instructions in ssot/.

engos-delivery-address-code-review.primary_job: Apply selected reviewer comments without changing unrelated code.
engos-delivery-address-code-review.use_when: A PR or MR already has concrete review feedback and the user has chosen what to fix.
engos-delivery-address-code-review.works_on: Existing review comments and the files they reference.
engos-delivery-address-code-review.main_output: Narrow code changes plus a comment-by-comment change summary.
engos-delivery-address-code-review.not_for: Proactive review before feedback exists, broad refactoring, or release readiness.
engos-delivery-address-code-review.authority: May edit only code tied to approved review comments.
engos-delivery-address-code-review.routing_question: Are we finding problems, or applying already-selected review feedback?

engos-memory-context-continuity.primary_job: Maintain durable evidence and conclusions during a long, multi-file investigation.
engos-memory-context-continuity.use_when: Analysis will span many files, turns, or context compactions.
engos-memory-context-continuity.works_on: Repository evidence, questions, hypotheses, and analysis state.
engos-memory-context-continuity.main_output: A durable analysis record that can be resumed without losing provenance.
engos-memory-context-continuity.not_for: A quick code review, transcript export, or a one-shot health audit.
engos-memory-context-continuity.authority: Analysis-state maintenance; it does not grant broader repo mutation authority.
engos-memory-context-continuity.routing_question: Does the investigation need resumable reasoning state rather than a one-time report?

engos-design-architecture.primary_job: Design a concrete system boundary, interface, schema, or migration with explicit trade-offs.
engos-design-architecture.use_when: The user needs an implementable technical design or architecture decision.
engos-design-architecture.works_on: Systems, APIs, components, data models, dependencies, and migrations.
engos-design-architecture.main_output: A chosen design with boundaries, alternatives, failure modes, migration, and rollback.
engos-design-architecture.not_for: General mentoring, choosing among arbitrary proposals without design work, or broad repo health scanning.
engos-design-architecture.authority: Advisory design; implementation requires separate authorization.
engos-design-architecture.routing_question: Is the deliverable a technical design, or merely a recommendation among existing options?

engos-optimization-auto-research.primary_job: Run a bounded evidence loop to discover whether one candidate actually outperforms another.
engos-optimization-auto-research.use_when: The user needs behavioral optimization, comparison, calibration, or promotion evidence.
engos-optimization-auto-research.works_on: Prompts, skills, workflows, tools, configurations, and other measurable candidates.
engos-optimization-auto-research.main_output: A reproducible experiment record and pass, fail, or inconclusive recommendation.
engos-optimization-auto-research.not_for: Stylistic polishing without measurement or self-promoting a UAC-produced candidate.
engos-optimization-auto-research.authority: Owns behavioral comparison; promotion still obeys independent hard gates and user authority.
engos-optimization-auto-research.routing_question: Do we need evidence of better behavior, or only a stronger draft?

engos-quality-code-review.primary_job: Find actionable defects and release risks in a diff, commit, or staged change.
engos-quality-code-review.use_when: Code exists and needs a quality gate before commit, push, merge, or release.
engos-quality-code-review.works_on: Git diffs, changed code, tests, and supporting repository evidence.
engos-quality-code-review.main_output: Prioritized findings with file evidence, severity, and a readiness verdict.
engos-quality-code-review.not_for: Applying reviewer comments, writing a test suite as the primary job, or general repo hygiene.
engos-quality-code-review.authority: Read-only review unless the user separately asks for fixes.
engos-quality-code-review.routing_question: Are we reviewing code for defects, applying feedback, or checking release mechanics?

engos-audit-code-health.primary_job: Audit an existing codebase for structural risks, hotspots, coupling, and maintainability problems.
engos-audit-code-health.use_when: The user wants a read-only, repository-wide technical health assessment.
engos-audit-code-health.works_on: Code structure, dependencies, size, dead code, ownership signals, and prior claims.
engos-audit-code-health.main_output: An evidence-backed structural risk report and prioritized remediation backlog.
engos-audit-code-health.not_for: Product feature progress, weekly git activity reporting, or designing a replacement architecture.
engos-audit-code-health.authority: Read-only audit; it does not implement repairs.
engos-audit-code-health.routing_question: Is the question about code structure, product completeness, or delivery activity?

engos-reconciliation-converge.primary_job: Reconcile competing proposals or evidence into one decision and explain what was rejected.
engos-reconciliation-converge.use_when: Several sources, recommendations, or options conflict and one coherent answer is needed.
engos-reconciliation-converge.works_on: Proposals, reviews, research findings, decisions, and trade-offs.
engos-reconciliation-converge.main_output: A unified recommendation with conflicts, rationale, confidence, and unresolved risks.
engos-reconciliation-converge.not_for: Creating a technical architecture from scratch or providing ongoing engineering mentorship.
engos-reconciliation-converge.authority: Advisory synthesis; it cannot manufacture consensus or evidence.
engos-reconciliation-converge.routing_question: Are there multiple competing inputs that must become one decision?

engos-browser-demo-recorder.primary_job: Plan and generate repeatable Playwright-based product demo recordings.
engos-browser-demo-recorder.use_when: A feature needs a scripted, realistic, recordable walkthrough.
engos-browser-demo-recorder.works_on: Runnable product flows, browser steps, pacing, fixtures, and capture settings.
engos-browser-demo-recorder.main_output: A demo plan and executable Playwright recording script.
engos-browser-demo-recorder.not_for: General end-to-end testing or presentation deck authoring.
engos-browser-demo-recorder.authority: Creates demo artifacts; deployment or publication needs separate approval.
engos-browser-demo-recorder.routing_question: Is the browser flow meant to prove behavior or communicate it as a demo?

engos-quality-docs-review.primary_job: Audit documentation structure, drift, explainability, and release hygiene.
engos-quality-docs-review.use_when: Repository documentation needs a systematic review or governance decision.
engos-quality-docs-review.works_on: README files, docs trees, generated docs, information architecture, and release documentation.
engos-quality-docs-review.main_output: A documentation findings report and prioritized, explainable improvement plan.
engos-quality-docs-review.not_for: Line-editing one prompt or generating a weekly intelligence report.
engos-quality-docs-review.authority: Review is read-only unless documentation edits are explicitly requested.
engos-quality-docs-review.routing_question: Is the problem document-system health or sentence-level instruction editing?

engos-content-dynamic-html-presentations.primary_job: Create polished standalone HTML presentations and deterministic export artifacts.
engos-content-dynamic-html-presentations.use_when: The requested deliverable is a slide deck or visual narrative rendered as HTML.
engos-content-dynamic-html-presentations.works_on: Presentation content, layout, visual assets, responsive slides, PNG, and PPTX export.
engos-content-dynamic-html-presentations.main_output: A runnable HTML deck with verified visual exports when requested.
engos-content-dynamic-html-presentations.not_for: Recording a live product demo or writing a plain text report.
engos-content-dynamic-html-presentations.authority: Creates local presentation artifacts; hosting and distribution require separate authority.
engos-content-dynamic-html-presentations.routing_question: Is the main artifact a deck, a live product demo, or a written report?

engos-audit-engineering-progress.primary_job: Turn repository activity into a periodic engineering progress and velocity dashboard.
engos-audit-engineering-progress.use_when: The user wants a repo-specific weekly or periodic report grounded primarily in git data.
engos-audit-engineering-progress.works_on: Commits, contributors, change volume, repositories, teams, and reporting periods.
engos-audit-engineering-progress.main_output: An HTML engineering activity dashboard with methods and caveats.
engos-audit-engineering-progress.not_for: Product backlog completeness, structural code health, or multi-source executive intelligence.
engos-audit-engineering-progress.routing_question: Is the question about engineering activity, product completeness, or code health?

engos-audit-feature-status.primary_job: Determine how complete a product feature is against intended scope and proof.
engos-audit-feature-status.use_when: The user asks what is backlog, in progress, done, missing, or moving slowly for a feature.
engos-audit-feature-status.works_on: Product scope, requirements, tickets, implementation evidence, tests, demos, and delivery state.
engos-audit-feature-status.main_output: A product-oriented completeness verdict, progress breakdown, gaps, and next actions.
engos-audit-feature-status.not_for: Repository-wide code health or a periodic git velocity dashboard.
engos-audit-feature-status.authority: Read-only analysis; status claims must be tied to evidence.
engos-audit-feature-status.routing_question: Are we asking whether the product feature is complete, how the repo is structured, or what activity occurred?

engos-quality-gitops-review.primary_job: Decide whether repository, CI, packaging, merge, tag, and release state is ready to ship.
engos-quality-gitops-review.use_when: The concern is Git hygiene or the operational release path rather than code semantics alone.
engos-quality-gitops-review.works_on: Branches, commits, PRs or MRs, CI, changelogs, packages, tags, remotes, and releases.
engos-quality-gitops-review.main_output: A release or merge readiness verdict with exact blockers and next commands.
engos-quality-gitops-review.not_for: Finding code defects as the primary task or applying selected reviewer comments.
engos-quality-gitops-review.authority: Review by default; merge, push, tag, or release requires explicit authorization.
engos-quality-gitops-review.routing_question: Is the blocker in code correctness or in the path from repo state to release?

engos-operations-ic-assistant.primary_job: Keep an Incident Commander on the declared incident process without taking command decisions.
engos-operations-ic-assistant.use_when: An active incident needs phase tracking, prompts, artifact checks, and missed-step warnings.
engos-operations-ic-assistant.works_on: Incident phases, decisions, roles, timelines, comms, evidence, and required artifacts.
engos-operations-ic-assistant.main_output: Process guidance, phase status, missing actions, and validated incident artifacts.
engos-operations-ic-assistant.not_for: General message triage, engineering mentoring, or making incident decisions for the commander.
engos-operations-ic-assistant.authority: Advisory process guard; the human Incident Commander retains decision authority.
engos-operations-ic-assistant.routing_question: Is there an active incident with a commander and a required process?

engos-meta-instruction-editor.primary_job: Make prompts and agent instructions plainer and easier to scan without silently changing behavior.
engos-meta-instruction-editor.use_when: The user asks to remove AI-ish phrasing, shorten instructions, apply developer style, or verify semantic preservation.
engos-meta-instruction-editor.works_on: Prompts, skills, agent instructions, policies, and workflow rules.
engos-meta-instruction-editor.main_output: An edited artifact, edit ledger, preservation map, size delta, and unproven behavioral claims.
engos-meta-instruction-editor.not_for: Behavioral promotion, broad documentation IA review, or multi-lens adversarial hardening.
engos-meta-instruction-editor.authority: May make proven safe fixes; semantic rewrites remain candidates requiring evidence.
engos-meta-instruction-editor.routing_question: Is the goal clearer language, a stronger artifact, or proof that behavior improved?

engos-audit-pitch-review.primary_job: Create or improve a Shape Up pitch until it is ready for a betting decision.
engos-audit-pitch-review.use_when: The artifact is a product pitch with appetite, problem, solution, rabbit holes, and no-gos.
engos-audit-pitch-review.works_on: Pitch documents, problem framing, scope, risks, alternatives, and betting readiness.
engos-audit-pitch-review.main_output: A scored or rewritten pitch with gaps and a betting recommendation.
engos-audit-pitch-review.not_for: Reporting current feature completion or synthesizing arbitrary proposals.
engos-audit-pitch-review.authority: Advisory pitch work; it does not make the betting decision.
engos-audit-pitch-review.routing_question: Is this a future investment pitch, a current feature status check, or a general decision synthesis?

engos-triage-my-inbox-chat-pulse.primary_job: Triage Gmail and Google Chat into a deterministic, low-noise attention queue.
engos-triage-my-inbox-chat-pulse.use_when: The user wants to know what messages need attention or wants an approved comms action workflow.
engos-triage-my-inbox-chat-pulse.works_on: Email, chat, priority rules, learned preferences, and explicit message actions.
engos-triage-my-inbox-chat-pulse.main_output: A prioritized communications table and proposed actions.
engos-triage-my-inbox-chat-pulse.not_for: A multi-source weekly team report or incident-command process management.
engos-triage-my-inbox-chat-pulse.authority: Triage is read-only; sends, archives, and deletes require the documented explicit approval path.
engos-triage-my-inbox-chat-pulse.routing_question: Is this personal communications triage, incident process, or a periodic intelligence report?

engos-delivery-resolve-conflict.primary_job: Resolve merge conflicts while preserving intent from both sides and documenting trade-offs.
engos-delivery-resolve-conflict.use_when: Git or content conflicts already exist and need structured, safe resolution.
engos-delivery-resolve-conflict.works_on: Conflicting hunks, branch intent, tests, and merge semantics.
engos-delivery-resolve-conflict.main_output: Resolved files plus a conflict ledger and verification result.
engos-delivery-resolve-conflict.not_for: General code review or high-level option synthesis without an actual conflict.
engos-delivery-resolve-conflict.authority: May edit conflict targets within the user-approved resolution scope.
engos-delivery-resolve-conflict.routing_question: Is there an actual merge conflict to resolve, or merely disagreement among proposals?

engos-meta-supercharge.primary_job: Harden a prompt, plan, proposal, or workflow using the smallest useful combination of critique modules.
engos-meta-supercharge.use_when: The user wants prompt improvement, adversarial challenge, proposal hardening, comparison, grading, or a compound module stack.
engos-meta-supercharge.works_on: Prompts, plans, workflows, proposals, decisions, and analysis artifacts.
engos-meta-supercharge.main_output: A materially improved artifact plus module-specific reasoning, grading, or debate outputs.
engos-meta-supercharge.not_for: Proving a candidate wins through behavioral trials or performing a specialist codebase audit by default.
engos-meta-supercharge.authority: Artifact hardening and routing; behavioral promotion belongs to Auto-Research.
engos-meta-supercharge.routing_question: Does the user want the artifact strengthened, or evidence that one strengthened variant performs best?

engos-quality-testing-review.primary_job: Design or generate tests, edge cases, and coverage improvements for a defined target.
engos-quality-testing-review.use_when: The primary deliverable is a unit, integration, end-to-end, edge-case, or coverage test plan or implementation.
engos-quality-testing-review.works_on: Code behavior, acceptance criteria, test suites, fixtures, and coverage evidence.
engos-quality-testing-review.main_output: Focused tests or a test plan with explicit expected behavior and failure boundaries.
engos-quality-testing-review.not_for: General code review or release-state verification.
engos-quality-testing-review.authority: May add tests when implementation is requested; production-code changes need separate scope.
engos-quality-testing-review.routing_question: Is the main task to test behavior, review code, or prove release readiness?

engos-memory-threader.primary_job: Export and package a conversation so its context can be recalled or handed off.
engos-memory-threader.use_when: The user wants a full-thread transcript, context packet, or memory-management artifact.
engos-memory-threader.works_on: Conversation history, turns, decisions, unresolved items, and handoff context.
engos-memory-threader.main_output: A portable transcript or structured context handoff.
engos-memory-threader.not_for: Maintaining a live multi-file investigation state or producing a weekly report.
engos-memory-threader.authority: Read and package conversation context; it does not change project state.
engos-memory-threader.routing_question: Are we exporting the conversation, or maintaining an ongoing evidence investigation?

engos-meta-uac-import.primary_job: Inspect an external prompt-like source and decide how, or whether, it should enter Core-Prompts.
engos-meta-uac-import.use_when: A prompt, skill, agent file, config, or URL is being considered for import or uplift.
engos-meta-uac-import.works_on: External source material, source provenance, capability classification, metadata, and landing plans.
engos-meta-uac-import.main_output: A source-fidelity assessment, structural uplift plan, metadata handoff, and safe apply decision.
engos-meta-uac-import.not_for: Claiming behavioral superiority or editing arbitrary prose with no import intent.
engos-meta-uac-import.authority: Structural intake only; behavioral promotion belongs to independent evaluation.
engos-meta-uac-import.routing_question: Are we importing a capability, editing instructions, or proving behavior?

engos-audit-weekly-intel.primary_job: Produce a fact-checked periodic narrative from several source systems with traceable appendices.
engos-audit-weekly-intel.use_when: Leadership or a team needs one forwardable weekly intelligence report across repos, trackers, and communications.
engos-audit-weekly-intel.works_on: Multiple source systems, reporting windows, metrics, claims, citations, and executive narrative.
engos-audit-weekly-intel.main_output: One executive report with technical appendices and internal consistency checks.
engos-audit-weekly-intel.not_for: A git-only engineering dashboard, personal inbox triage, or product feature completeness alone.
engos-audit-weekly-intel.authority: Read-only reporting; it must not modify source systems.
engos-audit-weekly-intel.routing_question: Is the report multi-source and executive, repo-activity focused, or about one feature's completeness?

engos-orchestration-batman.primary_job: Implements an authorized work item through an explicitly invoked, subagent-driven delivery protocol with written plans, TDD evidence, blocking milestone reviews, progress reporting, verification, documentation, and landing.
engos-orchestration-batman.use_when: A repository implementation needs independent subagents, controller-owned host-fit planning and evidence, adversarial backpressure, and authorized delivery to mainline. Trigger with batman.
engos-orchestration-batman.works_on: One scoped repository work item with success criteria, applicable instructions, a base revision, and explicit landing boundaries.
engos-orchestration-batman.main_output: Implemented behavior plus observed red, green, and mutation evidence; applicable milestone decisions; status reports; validation; documentation; Git health; and an authorized landing receipt.
engos-orchestration-batman.not_for: Advice-only, review-only, or one-pass editing requests, or work that cannot provide independent implementation and review subagents.
engos-orchestration-batman.authority: The controller coordinates subagents and performs authorized delivery actions; it never authors production code, failing tests, or implementation fixes, and metadata never auto-invokes the protocol.
engos-orchestration-batman.routing_question: Does this authorized repository change require subagent-driven implementation with blocking review backpressure and evidence through landing?

engos-design-plan-to-goal.primary_job: Compile a reviewed plan into a durable, host-aware goal, specification, and verifier packet.
engos-design-plan-to-goal.use_when: An implementation intent needs bounded long-running execution with repository evidence, honest completion criteria, and a verified host contract.
engos-design-plan-to-goal.works_on: A plan or intent, the target repository and rules, the active host, user-supplied bounds, protected surfaces, and acceptance evidence.
engos-design-plan-to-goal.main_output: Goal prose, specification, verifier and packet manifest, with research, trust, sealing status, host budget, and a supported launch command when ready.
engos-design-plan-to-goal.not_for: Ordinary one-step implementation, a repeatable loop catalog search, inventing a native runner, or executing the compiled goal without a separate request.
engos-design-plan-to-goal.authority: Compiles and validates the packet within current permissions. It does not implicitly create or operate a goal, implement source changes, approve operator checks, promote behavior, deploy, commit, or merge.
engos-design-plan-to-goal.routing_question: Does an existing plan need a durable goal/specification/verifier packet bound to a verified host?

engos-audit-opex-incident-review.primary_job: Audit the Operational Excellence incident estate against a prior snapshot and generate a decisions-first Daily OpEx Digest with owner obligations, progress, stalled work, DPAs, postmortems, evidence caveats, and optional incident drill-downs.
engos-audit-opex-incident-review.use_when: The user needs a current-versus-prior Operational Excellence board, DPA or postmortem tracking, owner accountability, estate patterns, or executive incident-review preparation.
engos-audit-opex-incident-review.works_on: Current and prior normalized incident snapshots backed by Jira records, DPA records, postmortem bodies, policy inputs, and retrieval coverage evidence.
engos-audit-opex-incident-review.main_output: A validated snapshot pair, evidence and comparison ledgers, and a deterministic Daily OpEx Digest in HTML with optional Markdown and incident drill-downs.
engos-audit-opex-incident-review.not_for: Active Incident Commander process support, Git-only engineering activity, broad weekly intelligence, or modifying Jira, Drive, owners, priorities, links, or statuses.
engos-audit-opex-incident-review.authority: Read incident and document evidence and write local audit artifacts only; external mutations, messages, uploads, and distribution require separate explicit authorization.
engos-audit-opex-incident-review.routing_question: Does this request require a stateful Operational Excellence incident-estate audit and Daily OpEx Digest?

loopy.primary_job: Discover, find, design, audit, run, or improve a bounded agent loop from scoped evidence.
loopy.use_when: Repeated work needs a feedback loop, an existing loop needs review, or an identified loop needs execution, debriefing, or publication preparation.
loopy.works_on: Scoped repositories and coding threads, loop prompts, the live Loop Library catalog, and completed run receipts.
loopy.main_output: Published-loop recommendations, a concise bounded loop, a loop audit or repair, an evidence-backed run receipt, a debrief, or an approved publication submission for the selected route.
loopy.not_for: One-shot work with no useful feedback cycle, a host-specific goal packet, or claiming publication from repository content alone.
loopy.authority: Selecting or crafting does not run a loop. A run permits only ordinary reversible actions in scope; schedules, production changes, destructive or privacy-sensitive actions, purchases, external messages, and publication require their explicit authority.
loopy.routing_question: Is the need to discover or operate a repeatable feedback loop, or to compile one implementation plan into a host-bound goal packet?

engos-design-experience.primary_job: Design or improve a coherent user experience through composition, interaction, and connected UI behavior.
engos-design-experience.use_when: The user needs experience decisions, comparisons, prototypes, or scoped UI implementation.
engos-design-experience.works_on: HTML reports and web, desktop, or mobile interfaces, their content, foundations, and relevant API/state contracts.
engos-design-experience.main_output: The requested artifact with its advantage, trade-offs, checks, and uncertainty at the requested fidelity.
engos-design-experience.authority: Honor the requested assessment, options, mockup, prototype, or implementation scope; design selection grants no external-action authority.
engos-design-experience.routing_question: Does the task require an experience decision or connected UI behavior?
